pulse: Weekend tape: NQ closed Fri at the highs (Nasdaq +2.3% to 24,129, best Thanksgiving week since Apr '25) on AI/memory dip-buying, but fresh Hormuz blockade enforcement, Houthi missiles at Saudi and Nvidia Blackwell-in-Shanghai headlines set up a headline-risk Sunday reopen.
bias: mixed — AI momentum and a strong Fri close favor risk-on, offset by U.S. disabling a blockade-runner in the Gulf of Oman, Brent $95.44 (+3% wk) into Sunday OPEC+, NVDA export-control headlines and ~$100B CTA supply flagged for next week.
items: X News/CENTCOM (~7:32 AM ET): U.S. aircraft disabled Palau-flagged M/V Pacific Archer from Bandar Abbas trying to breach the Iran port blockade in the Gulf of Oman — Bearish NQ (CL bid risk Sunday)
@FirstSquawk (~7:18 AM ET): Saudi-led coalition intercepts two more Houthi missiles toward southern Saudi (after ~4:27 AM ballistic missile, Jazan alert) — Bearish NQ
X News/Bloomberg (~6:26 AM ET): Nvidia GB300 NVL72/Blackwell racks found at a Shanghai data-center site tied to Megaspeed — Bearish NQ (NVDA export-control risk)
X News (~12:57 AM ET): Fri close S&P +1.6% 7,297.49, Nasdaq +2.3% 24,129.50, Dow +1.2%; SNDK +16%, MU +7.6% memory rebound — Bullish NQ
@WatcherGuru (~2:23 AM ET): Trump family's World Liberty USD1 stablecoin depegs; Justin Sun accuses WLFI of fraud (~2:43 AM) — Mixed NQ (crypto-equity risk)
trump: No new market-moving remarks overnight; Fri night he warned the U.S. would 'absolutely hit Pickaxe Mountain' near Natanz if activity resumes and backed NVDA CEO Huang's reinstatement. Weekend crypto noise: his family's WLFI USD1 stablecoin depegged.
watch: Sun OPEC+ meeting; Sun 6:00 PM ET futures reopen (Hormuz/blockade, Houthi headlines); Mon Dec 1 ISM Mfg 10:00 AM ET, MRVL & OKTA AMC; Tue Dec 2 CRM & SNOW AMC; Dec 9 FOMC (hike ~fully priced).
